task: Implement Animated Sequential Hero Slogans with Entrance/Exit Animations
objective: Replace static hero slogan with three dynamic phrases that appear sequentially with unique entrance animations. Each phrase should have a distinct animation personality while maintaining brand visual language (Anton display font, orange/green accents, mechanical 2px borders).

sloganContent.phrase: All the Action. None of the Lag.

global.stageDuration: 2.5 seconds total for all three phrases to complete

slogan_1_entry.name: Bounce + Scale (High Energy Entrance)
slogan_1_entry.technique: CSS keyframes + Framer Motion (or React Spring)
slogan_1_entry.notes: Bouncy easing for kinetic energy feel — aligns with 'Action' theme

slogan_2_entry.name: Slide In + Tilt (Confident Entrance)
slogan_2_entry.notes: Smooth, elastic easing for confident arrival — aligns with 'Everywhere' ubiquity

slogan_3_entry.name: Expand + Letter-Spacing (Premium Unveil)
slogan_3_entry.notes: Elegant entrance revealing quality and polish — aligns with 'Quality' promise

accentStyling.rule: Each accent word (Action, Lag, Match, etc.) receives a distinct color per slogan
accentStyling.implementation: Use <span> wrapper with inline style or CSS class for each accent word

interactionPatterns.onMount: Automatically play animation sequence once on component mount
interactionPatterns.onReplay: Provide optional replay button or manual trigger to restart sequence

responsiveness.mobile: Font sizes compress via clamp() — animations remain identical
responsiveness.desktop: Standard animation timing — full visual impact

implementationApproach.framework: React 18+ with Framer Motion (recommended) OR React Spring OR pure CSS

optionA.name: Framer Motion (Recommended)
optionA.rationale: Built-in stagger/sequence control, smooth on low-end devices, easy exit animations

optionB.name: Pure CSS + React State
usage: Toggle class names based on React state
Use useEffect to manage animation timing

steps: Create HeroSlogans.jsx with three separate slogan components (or one with mapped state)
Import animation library (Framer Motion or equivalent)
Define keyframe variants for each slogan entry/exit
Apply classes or style props to slogans based on current state
Wrap accent words in <span> elements with aria labels if needed

codingGuidelines.cssClasses: Use BEM naming if using pure CSS: .hero-slogan__wrapper, .hero-slogan__phrase, .hero-slogan__accent
a11yConsiderations: Add aria-label to slogan wrapper: 'Animated slogan reveal sequence'
Ensure reduced-motion media query respects prefers-reduced-motion and skips animations if enabled
Do not use role='region' unless slogans announce dynamically — static content doesn't need it
performanceNotes: Use transform and opacity for GPU acceleration — avoid animating layout properties (width, height)
Consider will-change: transform on animated elements
Test on mid-range devices (iPhone SE, Android budget phones) for jank
Use CSS containment (contain: layout) if browser support allows

integrationWithHero.replacesCurrentSlogan: The existing static slogan text in src/components/Hero.jsx should be replaced by the HeroSlogans component
maintainedElements: Existing Hero component structure (background video, overlay, etc.) remains unchanged
CTA buttons in Hero can be repositioned below slogans or remain as-is

visualRegressionTests: Capture before/after screenshots of hero section on desktop and mobile
Verify animations play at correct timing intervals
Verify animations exit cleanly when component unmounts
interactionTests: Verify replay button triggers animation sequence again
Verify animations complete before CTA button is interactive
Verify no layout shift or jank during animations
a11yTests: Run with prefers-reduced-motion enabled — animations should disable
Screen reader passes through key content without duplicate/conflicting announcements

deliverables: index.css (or HeroSlogans.module.css) — all keyframe definitions and class rules
Optional: Replay/control button for testing animations
Optional: Storybook story showing all animation states
successCriteria: All three slogans appear sequentially with zero visual jank
Each slogan has unique, recognizable entrance animation
Total animation sequence completes in ~2.5 seconds
Accent words are visually emphasized via color and weight
Animations respect prefers-reduced-motion on supported browsers
Component remains responsive on mobile (font scales, touch-friendly)
Animation can be replayed without page reload
CTA button appears after slogans complete
